speaker: Leonard
text: Hi, Tom Sheldon. Didn't I explain to you about your little mistake in the cafeteria?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Leonard, this is Tom. Yes, you were very clear, as was everyone else at the table. Tom, however, has been chosen by science as a suitable mate for Penny.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, what passes for science on dating sites. They claim to use heuristic algorithms, but it may well be hokum.

speaker: Leonard
text: You got Penny to sign up for online dating?

speaker: Sheldon
text: No, no, no, of course not. See, I used trickery and deceit.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Tom is a paramedic with the fire department, but he's going to med school at night, uh, he likes the outdoors, and, uh, strong women who initiate sex.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm surprised you struck out with Penny. Apparently she's a big ol' five. Oh, good, you got my note. Penny, I'd like you to meet Tom. Uh, Penny, this is Tom. Tom, may I present Penny?

speaker: Penny
text: Sheldon, what do you want? Yeah, hey, listen. As long as I'm here on a quest with a bunch of noobs, they don't know what they're doing. We've got one assassin, three spellcasters, and no tank.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Can we talk about this later? Wouldn't you prefer to socialize with Tom, who is a sexually passive outdoorsman?

speaker: Penny
text: No, no, no, no, I need you now.

speaker: Penny
text: Whatever, I'll figure it out myself.

speaker: Leonard
text: Bye, Penny. I'm sorry to intrude.
